name: statusline
description: A live status line around the prompt: model, 7d and 5h limits, prompts and requests, main and subagent costs, the prompt cache's time left, and the project's git and pull request state; plus /statusline:handoff, which writes a handoff document before the cache goes cold.

row_git.title: Statusline: Git row
row_git.description: The project folder, branch, worktree, pull request and changes, above the prompt. true (default) / false

row_git_position.title: Statusline: Git row › position
row_git_position.description: Where the git row draws: above the prompt, or under it below Claude Code's hint line. above (default) / below

row_status.title: Statusline: Status row
row_status.description: The model, limits, context, turns, costs and cache, under the prompt. true (default) / false

row_status_position.title: Statusline: Status row › position
row_status_position.description: Where the status row draws: above the prompt, or under it below Claude Code's hint line. above / below (default)

segment_model.title: Statusline: Status row › model
segment_model.description: The main loop's model. true (default) / false

segment_limits.title: Statusline: Status row › limits
segment_limits.description: The 7d and 5h limit bars. true (default) / false

segment_context.title: Statusline: Status row › context
segment_context.description: The context window bar. true (default) / false

segment_turns.title: Statusline: Status row › turns
segment_turns.description: Prompts sent and the model requests made for them. true (default) / false

segment_tokens.title: Statusline: Status row › costs
segment_tokens.description: What the main conversation and its subagents cost. true (default) / false

segment_cache.title: Statusline: Status row › cache
segment_cache.description: The prompt cache's time left and what it costs. true (default) / false

compact.title: Statusline: Compact spacing
compact.description: No space between the tags of the status row, nor in the git row's folders, branch and worktree. true / false (default)

auto_handoff.title: Statusline: Hand off before the cache goes cold
auto_handoff.description: Runs /statusline:handoff once while the session is idle, a few minutes before the prompt cache expires, and writes HANDOFF-<date-time>.md at the project's root. It runs again only after your next prompt. true (default) / false

keep_warm_pings.title: Statusline: Keep the cache warm (pings)
keep_warm_pings.description: How many minimal prompts the mod sends while the session is idle, each just before the prompt cache expires, to keep it warm; the handoff runs after the last one, on a 5-minute cache too. About 25 pings cost as much as writing a 5-minute cache once, and a fresh session from the handoff is usually cheaper and answers faster, so keep this low. (default: 0)

fresh_start.title: Statusline: Offer a fresh start from the handoff
fresh_start.description: Once the cache is cold and this session wrote a handoff, a line under the prompt shows what the next message costs here and what a fresh session from the handoff costs, with a button that starts it. true (default) / false

auto_compact.title: Statusline: Compact when the smart zone is nearly used
auto_compact.description: Runs /compact once while the session is idle, as soon as the context has used 90% of the smart zone. It runs again only after your next prompt. true / false (default)

compact_hint.title: Statusline: Offer a compaction when the smart zone is nearly used
compact_hint.description: Once the context has used 90% of the smart zone, a line under the prompt offers to compact the session, with a button that does. true (default) / false

dismiss_minutes.title: Statusline: Dismissed offers stay hidden (minutes)
dismiss_minutes.description: How long the cross on the fresh-start and compaction lines hides its line. 0 hides it for the rest of the session. (default: 0)

smart_zone.title: Statusline: Smart zone on the context bar
smart_zone.description: The context bar's top half shows the smart zone left. Off, the bar shows only the context window left, in full-height blocks. true (default) / false

smart_zone_tokens.title: Statusline: Smart zone (tokens)
smart_zone_tokens.description: The context size up to which recall stays precise; the context bar's top half shows how much of it is left. (default: 200000)

turn_rate.title: Statusline: Turn line › tokens per second
turn_rate.description: The tokens a turn generated per second, in the line that closes it (Cooked at 52 tok/s for 7s · done 11:22 PM). true (default) / false
